centralQuestion: What exactly does the API promise, and how can providers and consumers verify that promise?
incomingBoundary: Basic programming ability and no assumed OpenAPI experience.

languages.strategy: Both Python/FastAPI and TypeScript/Fastify are used symmetrically to prove that the contract is language-neutral.

outgoingBoundary: A frozen API 1.1 contract, operation ledger, schema fixtures, security decisions, workflows, and provider-neutral behavioral scenarios.
responsibility: Define and verify the public HTTP contract.
title: OpenAPI Contract Engineering

versions.databaseMigrations: None. Persistence is deliberately instructional and non-durable.
